name: content-safety-lock
description: Voluntary adult content blocker with self-lock mode for adults seeking structured guardrails

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir build/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd build/chrome && zip -qr ../chrome.zip .
scripts.package:safari: npm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter build/safari --project-location safari-project --no-open --force
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir build/firefox
